proposed_sites.reason: Module-level assignment to openai.api_key no longer configures the client in v1; must be replaced with an explicit client = OpenAI(api_key=...) construction (breaking change #1).

Module-level namespaced call pattern openai.ChatCompletion.create(...) is removed in v1 and must migrate to client.chat.completions.create(...) (breaking change #2). Reached via chat() -> get_response() -> /get route handler, so this is a live call path.

considered_and_rejected.reason: Dict-style response access is explicitly out of scope for this migration; both dict-style and attribute-style access remain valid in v1.
